text:
Leah (AE): Hi team — running a quick sync. Marta from OrionHealth wants a short POC to validate streaming + function/tool calls and structured JSON output. They also attached a security questionnaire and asked for a rough reserved-capacity price estimate. Can we confirm blockers?
Sam (Presales): @Leah thanks. Key asks: 1) streaming session (SSE/WS) with tool calls 2) schema'd JSON (no HTML) from func call responses 3) retention & encryption answers for SQ 4) latency SLO ~120ms p50 for 512-token responses.
Marta (Customer): Correct. Also need on-prem option (VPC or air-gapped) for PHI, and short-lived creds for our connector. We can share the SQ PDF once you confirm contact.
Ravi (SDK Eng): We can demo with Python/Go SDKs. Example Python streaming handshake (SSE) below: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
with client.stream("model-x", input="extract_entities") as s:
    for event in s:
        if event.type == "tool_call":
            print(event.payload)
```
For structured output use function-calling + schema enforcement: function return must be valid JSON matching schema. We have a small helper to validate on the client.
Sam (Presales): For the POC flow, propose: quick sandbox (hosted) to validate schema/tooling, then a week-long Dedicated trial in EU for latency tests, then Private eval if they need on-prem. Budget ask?
Leah (AE): Marta needs a ballpark for reserved capacity (monthly) and a burst/overage model. Can we give an honest estimate for a 2-rack equivalent (peak 300 qps, average 80 qps)?
Ravi (SDK Eng): Rough numbers: Dedicated starter (2x A40-class GPUs) estimate: $12k–$18k/mo depending on quantization and batching. Burst credit model: 2x baseline + pay-as-you-go at hosted rates for overflow. Will refine after we see token distribution.
Jules (Security): For the SQ: we can answer SOC2 status, encryption at rest (KMS) and in transit, key rotation, and IP allowlist. On-prem package covers HSM/KMS integration and audit log exports. Need the exact questionnaire fields — prefer a CSV. Also: clarify whether data persistence for embeddings is allowed.
Marta (Customer): They cannot store embeddings outside our environment. On-prem is preferred but could evaluate Dedicated if contractually isolated.
Sam (Presales): Action items: 1) Leah: send SQ to Jules (once Marta uploads) 2) Ravi: prepare two mini-demos (hosted streaming + Dedicated perf harness) 3) Pricing ops: draft 2 quote flavors (Dedicated trial + Private migration) 4) DevEx: sample schema + function-calling example for their devs.
Leah (AE): ETA: I'll drop the SQ link here by EOD. Also they asked about structured output validation — Ravi, can you attach a minimal JSON schema example?
Ravi (SDK Eng): Sample schema inline: 
```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "patient_id": {"type": "string"},
    "diagnoses": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}
  },
  "required": ["patient_id", "diagnoses"]
}
```
We validate on both client and server and will surface a validation error event in streams.
Marta (Customer): Good. Also needs proof for encryption compliance and where logs live.
Jules (Security): We'll provide a standard answers package (SOC2, encryption, KMS options, dataflow diagram). For on-prem we outline responsibilities matrix.
RedwoodBot: Deploy job #rwd-deploy-881 succeeded to sandbox (sha:abc123) — streaming sample app available at https://sandbox.redwood.local/streams/demo
Sam (Presales): I'll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with Marta + their infra lead tomorrow. Leah — can you confirm time?
Leah (AE): Confirmed — sending invite for 10am CET.
Marta (Customer): Thanks all — looking forward. One more: can we get a latency runbook in advance?
Ravi (SDK Eng): Will attach a short runbook (how we measure p50/p95, load tool, and recommended batching configs).
Leah (AE): Nice. I'll collect SQ + contract constraints, then we iterate on pricing. :thumbsup:
Sam (Presales): Closing note — keep the POC scope tight: streaming handshake + 2 sample function calls returning schema'd JSON. Anything beyond that we scope separately.
